recipes.need: Dropdown / picker / choose one option from a list
recipes.keywords: dropdown picker choose option menu select one
recipes.how: Select (inline trigger) opens a BottomSheet; each option is a ListCell as="label" with a Radio. Apply on tap — no confirm button for a single choice.

recipes.need: Confirmation dialog / are you sure / review before placing
recipes.keywords: confirm dialog modal popup alert are you sure review
recipes.how: BottomSheet with a BottomSheetHeader (heading = the question), the facts as ListCell rows, and a horizontal ButtonGroup: secondary Cancel + primary (or buy/sell) confirm on the right.

recipes.need: Filter chips / segmented control / quick filters
recipes.keywords: chips filter segmented control toggle group quick filter pill
recipes.how: Tabs appearance="pill" for filters, "pill-group" for a segmented control (2–4 options). Not Tags — tags are never tappable.
Actionbar search mode at the top, results as ListCell rows, SkeletonListRow while loading, EmptyState for no results (with a Clear action).

recipes.need: Success / result message after an action
recipes.keywords: toast snackbar success message notification order placed
recipes.how: Aerobar floating, type=success (or danger). One line; action optional ("View").

recipes.need: Inline info / warning / error banner on a page
recipes.keywords: banner alert info warning error notice inline message
recipes.how: Inline Aerobar (not floating) with type discover / warning / danger, placed at the top of the content it is about.

recipes.need: Order pad / trade ticket / buy sell form
recipes.keywords: order pad trade ticket buy sell quantity price place order quantity lots qty stepper
recipes.how: Actionbar (asset + Select switcher + PriceChange), Tabs (Delivery / Intraday) in the actionbar's bottom slot, order-type pill Tabs, rows of Label + Select (Quantity ↕) + Stepper, TextField for price, a Card filled with margin/charges, and a ButtonGroup with one Buy or Sell button (lg). One primary action.

recipes.need: Watchlist / holdings row with price and change
recipes.keywords: watchlist row stock row holding price change sparkline ticker
recipes.how: ListCell: label = symbol, description = exchange or qty; trailing = Sparkline + a right-aligned column with the price (Label/14) and PriceChange (sm).

recipes.keywords: portfolio summary total pnl p&l invested current value returns header
recipes.how: Card static (or filled on white): Select (Total P&L ↕ Day P&L) as the label, the value in Heading/24, PriceChange lg with arrow, then invested / current in a two-column Label/Description grid. Optional Chart area below.

recipes.need: Loading state for a list or feed
recipes.keywords: loading list skeleton shimmer placeholder fetching
recipes.how: SkeletonListRow × the number of rows that fit (usually 6–8) inside a container with aria-busy="true" and a name. Never a spinner for content.

recipes.keywords: empty no data nothing yet no results first time zero state
recipes.how: EmptyState with a short heading, one sentence and at most one action (tertiary or primary if it is the screen's main job).

recipes.keywords: date range period filter report statement from to calendar
recipes.how: Select (chevron, md subtle) shows the period; tapping opens a BottomSheet with preset pill Tabs (1W 1M 3M 1Y Custom), DatePicker mode="range" for Custom, and a ButtonGroup Clear / Apply.

recipes.keywords: settings preference toggle switch row on off notifications
recipes.how: ListCell as="label" with a Switch trailing; the whole row toggles. Never as="button" (a button can't contain a control).

recipes.keywords: steps progress kyc onboarding stepper wizard completion
recipes.how: ProgressBar (status success when done) with "Step 2 of 4" as text above; the steps as ListCell rows with a check icon for done ones.

recipes.need: Key stats / details grid (open, high, low, lot size)
recipes.keywords: key stats details grid open high low lot size contract info market depth grey panel inset filled contract details
recipes.how: Card variant="filled" with a two-column grid: label (Description/12, content-secondary) above value (Label/14, content-primary). Gaps spacing/12 × spacing/16.

recipes.need: Asset / stock page header with price
recipes.keywords: asset page stock header price ltp chart instrument
recipes.how: Actionbar with back; Select lg as the asset switcher; LTP in Heading/24; PriceChange md with arrow and (percent); Chart candle or area; pill-group Tabs for 1D 1W 1M 1Y 5Y.

recipes.keywords: badge count number notification dot unread
recipes.how: No component yet (gap). Use a Tag neutral sm with the number, or ListCell's dot for 'has new'. Propose a Badge only if it appears in 3+ places (PLAYBOOK §2).
